2608.04828.title: Skill-Use: Can LLMs Actually Use Skills in Agentic Harnesses?
2608.04828.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on skills, structured documents that specify when to act, which procedure to follow, and which tools are allowed. Existing evaluations mostly judge the quality of a skill or its contribution to task success, leaving unexamined whether an agent can recognize a relevant skill and apply it on its own. We introduce Skill-Use, a benchmark that evaluates skill use under progressive disclosure, where an agent sees only a skill's name and short description and must retrieve the full procedure before following it. Skill-Use separates three facets of skill use. Trigger measures whether the agent invokes the relevant skill, Compliance measures how faithfully it follows the prescribed procedure, and Boundary measures whether it avoids forbidden operations. A Skill-Use (SU) score combines the three and credits execution only after the skill is triggered. Skill-Use pairs 79 real skills with 177 executable tasks across nine domains, each grounded in real files, run in an isolated Docker sandbox, and scored by a trajectory-based rubric. Evaluating eight LLMs under two agent harnesses, we find that reliable skill use remains out of reach, as the strongest configuration reaches an SU of only 0.613. Triggering and procedural compliance fail as independent bottlenecks, and both scores and model rankings shift with the harness, so skill use behaves as a capability conditioned on the harness rather than a fixed property of the model.
2608.04828.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理越來越依賴技能、結構化文件，這些文件規定了何時行動、遵循哪種程序以及允許使用哪些工具。現有的評估主要判斷技能的質量或其對任務成功的貢獻，卻未檢視代理是否能夠識別相關技能並自行應用。我們引入了Skill-Use，一個在漸進式披露下評估技能使用的基準，其中代理僅看到技能的名稱和簡短描述，必須在遵循之前檢索完整程序。Skill-Use將技能使用分為三個方面。觸發測量代理是否調用相關技能，合規性測量其遵循規定程序的忠實程度，邊界測量其是否避免禁止的操作。Skill-Use（SU）分數結合了這三個方面，並在技能被觸發後才給予執行的信用。Skill-Use將79個真實技能與九個領域中的177個可執行任務配對，每個任務都基於真實文件，在隔離的Docker沙箱中運行，並根據基於軌跡的標準進行評分。在兩個代理框架下評估八個LLM，我們發現可靠的技能使用仍然難以達成，因為最強的配置僅達到0.613的SU。觸發和程序合規性作為獨立瓶頸失敗，且隨著框架的變化，分數和模型排名都會改變，因此技能使用表現為一種依賴於框架的能力，而不是模型的固定屬性。
